q: What grid emission factor should a Kenyan factory use for Scope 2?
title: Kenya grid factor for factories
short: Kenya's grid is mostly geothermal, hydro and wind, with thermal plants running in dry years, so the factor is low, usually under 0.2 kg CO2 per kWh. Take the official or IEA figure for the reporting year and cite it, because a dry year with more thermal generation can push it up.
audience: Manufacturers and exporters in Kenya reporting Scope 2 to buyers and lenders

p: Hydro output varies with rainfall. In a dry year more oil fired plants run, so use the figure for your actual year if one exists.

ul: Using a world average, which badly overstates Kenyan grid power.

p: kWh from bills, factor, source and year on the same line.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills into a dated, fingerprinted record per site and applies the grid factor you choose with its source and year shown, so a buyer can see exactly which figure was used.

sources.label: International Energy Agency, country energy data (iea.org)
